boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Florida Southern College study environments, from individual carrels and library workspaces to computer-equipped residential spaces.

cards.title: Roux Library Private Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Roux Library, second floor
cards.notes: Use a second-floor private carrel when you need an individual setup with a chair, table, and electrical outlet. These rooms are first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: A one-person, outlet-equipped study option inside Roux Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern students, staff, and faculty may use six private second-floor Roux Library carrels; each has a chair, table, and electrical outlet, and is for one person at a time.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Roux Library | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Florida Southern College students, staff, and faculty; first-come, first-served; one person per room.

cards.title: McKay Archives Private Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: McKay Archives, second floor
cards.notes: Set up in a McKay Archives carrel for a solo work session with a chair, table, and power. Bring your FSC affiliation; rooms are not reservable.
cards.short_summary: Four individual study carrels in the college archives building.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern students, staff, and faculty may use four private second-floor McKay Archives carrels with a chair, table, and electrical outlet; they are first-come, first-served.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Roux Library | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Restricted to Florida Southern College students, staff, and faculty; first-come, first-served; one person per room.

cards.title: Roux Library Group Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Roux Library
cards.notes: Choose the library’s group-study seating when you are working through a project together. Confirm current availability with library staff before relying on a particular area.
cards.short_summary: Library seating explicitly designated for group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Roux Library reports 39 seats in group study areas.
cards.source_title: About Roux Library | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Priority use of library facilities is reserved for Florida Southern students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Roux Library Meeting Rooms
cards.subtitle: Roux Library
cards.notes: Plan a collaborative session in the library’s meeting-room seating areas, then check with the library about current room availability or any room-use procedures.
cards.short_summary: A meeting-room option within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Roux Library reports 61 seats in meeting rooms.
cards.source_title: About Roux Library | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Priority use of library facilities is reserved for Florida Southern students, faculty, and staff; verify current room procedures with the library.

cards.title: TûTû’s Cyber Café
cards.subtitle: Roux Library
cards.notes: Work from the café’s group-study setting when a table-and-lounge environment suits your task. Check café and library operations before making it your study stop.
cards.short_summary: A named Roux Library café space with documented group-study seating.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern states that TûTû’s Cyber Café in Roux Library was remodeled to add group study spaces; the library lists 40 seats there.
cards.source_title: Roux Library History | McKay Archives | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Located inside Roux Library; a café may offer items for purchase, so confirm current operations and seating access.

cards.title: Roux Library Computer Terminal Seating
cards.subtitle: Roux Library
cards.notes: Use the library’s computer-terminal seating for online research or coursework when you need an on-site workstation. Ask staff if you need help locating a terminal.
cards.short_summary: On-site library workstation seating for computer-based academic work.
cards.evidence_claim: Roux Library has carrel and computer-terminal seating for 216 users.
cards.source_title: About Roux Library | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Priority use of library facilities is reserved for Florida Southern students, faculty, and staff.

cards.title: Rinker Technology Center Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Rinker Technology Center
cards.notes: Head to Rinker when your assignment needs campus hardware: the lab provides PCs, Macs, printers, and scanner stations for academic work.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused workroom with computers, printing, and scanning.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern’s Rinker Technology Center has a lab with more than 30 PCs and Macs, printers, and three scanner stations.
cards.source_title: Office of Information Technology Services | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Intended for students; confirm current lab availability and any campus authentication requirements with Technology Services.

cards.title: Wright Team Lounge
cards.subtitle: Jenkins Field House 019
cards.notes: Try this calming lounge for a study-area setup with fidgets and yoga mats. It is a sensible choice when you want a lower-stimulation work break between tasks.
cards.short_summary: A sensory lounge that explicitly includes study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Wright Team Lounge in Jenkins Field House 019 provides a calming space with study areas, fidgets, and yoga mats.
cards.source_title: Office of Student Disability Services | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Located in Jenkins Field House room 019; verify current availability with Student Disability Services.

cards.title: Dell Hall Lobby Study Tables
cards.subtitle: Dell Hall lobby
cards.notes: Dell residents can use the lobby’s study tables for a short working session near the residential core. Bring your residence-hall access card for entry.
cards.short_summary: Study tables in Dell Hall’s spacious residential lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern describes Dell Hall’s spacious lobby as having study tables, and identifies residence halls as swipe-access only.
cards.access_notes: Dell Hall is swipe-access only, limiting entry to residents of the building.

cards.title: Allan Spivey Hall First-Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: Allan Spivey Hall, first floor
cards.notes: Use the furnished first-floor lounge tables for quiet study if you live in Spivey. The lounge is inside a swipe-access residence hall, so plan accordingly.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall lounge with tables specifically furnished for quiet study.
cards.evidence_claim: Florida Southern states that Allan Spivey Hall’s first-floor lounge is furnished with tables for quiet study, and that residence halls are swipe-access only.
cards.source_title: Allan Spivey Hall | Florida Southern College
cards.access_notes: Allan Spivey Hall is swipe-access only, limiting entry to residents of the building.
